_comment: Reviewed TEMPLATE of the PodInstallationPreparation input to Relay's scripts/prepare-pod-installation.ts for the first researcher installation (docs/runbooks/relay-researcher-installation.md, step I4). installationPolicy is the owner-decided ceiling (relay#277 comment 122379, G4): 2000m / 4096 MiB / 10240 MiB scratch / 512 processes, lease 900 s, lifetime 8 h, no egress destination slugs; it must admit Relay's ROLE_BASELINES.researcher template (packages/infrastructure-protocol/baselines.ts: 1000m / 2048 MiB / 4096 MiB / 512, lease 900 s, lifetime 8 h, idle 1800 s, egressDestinations []), and a lease ceiling below 900 s makes the tool refuse it. Every value that is not an OPERATOR-FILLS string is decided by this review and must reach the tool unchanged; scripts/relay-researcher-bundle.py check compares the bundle's 00-definition.json with this file and refuses any difference outside the OPERATOR-FILLS leaves. Remove this _comment key from the operator's copy: the tool's schema is strict. executionEgressArtifacts[0].sha256 is the digest of the egress stage kubernetes/apps/relay-researcher/installation/kustomization.yaml includes (execution-egress.yaml aa11c229...8405 today; qualification-egress.yaml f6d3187c...282f after the runbook's qualification-stage switch).
sourceCommit: OPERATOR-FILLS: the reviewer-merged 40-hex Relay commit (= kubernetes/apps/relay-researcher/pins sourceCommit)
agentImage: OPERATOR-FILLS: publication.image of the agent's publish.py receipt (= pins agentImage)

identity.installationId: OPERATOR-FILLS: from the approval receipt (= pins installationId)
identity.installationPublicKey: OPERATOR-FILLS: raw base64url Ed25519 public half of the installation key, as approved

installationPolicy.allowedImageDigests: OPERATOR-FILLS: [the worker runtime image digest from its publish.py receipt]

binding: OPERATOR-FILLS: the release's PodRuntimeBinding (runtime manifest + image, sealed researcher template, identities, placements). Its researcher placement must be {tier, binding, runtimeClassName: relay-gvisor, overhead {milliCpu 80, memoryMiB 24}, nodeSelector including kubernetes.io/hostname: relay-worker-1 and ailab.io/relay-worker-pool: "true", tolerations [dedicated=relay-worker:NoSchedule]}; its policyDigest must be Relay contentDigest("relay.infrastructure/v1/installation-policy", installationPolicy) of THIS file's installationPolicy, so the ceilings above are part of the binding; the binding is the same in both egress stages, so from the start it must also carry the G3 fields the qualification stage needs (scripts/relay-researcher-bundle.py check refuses a binding without them, or with different values, in either stage): hostAliases {hub: 10.96.0.40, router: 10.96.0.41, candidateJournal: 10.96.0.42} (the Services relay-internal-tls/relay-hub-tls, relay-internal-tls/relay-router-tls and relay-candidate-journal/relay-candidate-journal); runtime.manifest.supervisorConfig.hubOrigin https://relay.chifor.me with hubCaPath /etc/relay/hub-ca.pem and hubCaSha256 = the hub-ca artifact's sha256 = 3d109e83f3e144daf1022cff5af22cbeda668db9bb1f4b25fc42f179254ad4c3 (docs/relay-workers/researcher-runtime-ca.crt, the ailab root CA); every runtime.manifest.holderProfiles.workerTemplates[].definition.holder.router with origin https://router.chifor.me and holder.communication with origin https://relay.chifor.me, each with caFile naming a packaged runtime artifact (recommended /etc/relay/hub-ca.pem) and caSha256 = that same sha256
